"""Repro for models.E015 false positive on ordering with isnull lookup."""
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, "C:/Users/agent/work/work/django-12858-panel")

import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
)
django.setup()

from django.db import models  # noqa: E402


class Product(models.Model):
    parent = models.ForeignKey("self", models.CASCADE, null=True)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"


class Supply(models.Model):
    product = models.ForeignKey(Product, models.CASCADE)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"


class Stock(models.Model):
    supply = models.ForeignKey(Supply, models.CASCADE)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"
        ordering = ["supply__product__parent__isnull"]


errors = Stock.check()
print("check() errors:", errors)
e015 = [e for e in errors if e.id == "models.E015"]
print("E015 raised:", bool(e015))

# Also confirm the ORM itself accepts the ordering (as in the ticket).
from django.db import connection  # noqa: E402

with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(Product)
    se.create_model(Supply)
    se.create_model(Stock)

qs = Stock.objects.order_by("supply__product__parent__isnull")
print("order_by SQL compiles:", str(qs.query)[:120].replace("\n", " "))
print("REPRO:", "E015-RAISED" if e015 else "NO-E015")
